title: Bacterial expression and protein purification of mini-fluorescence-activating proteins
protocol: Inoculate a single colony from an agar plate into 50.0 mL of LB or TBII media supplemented with carbenicillin.
Alternatively, inoculate 25.0 μL of overnight-grown culture into 500 mL of the same media.
Or, inoculate 25.0 μL of a 20% glycerol culture stock into 1.00 L of the same media.
Grow cells at 37°C shaking at 200-250 rpm overnight with 500 µM IPTG final concentration added either prior to inoculation or 4 hours before harvesting cells.
Harvest cells by centrifugation at 3,000-4,000xg for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend cell pellets in 20.0-30.0 mL of lysis buffer supplemented with PMSF and DNase I.
Lysate cells via sonication at 40-70% amplitude.
Alternatively, disrupt cells using FastPrep-96 at 1,600 rpm with glass beads.
Or, use a microfluidizer to lyse cells at 18,000 psi.
Centrifuge crude cell lysates at 24,000xg for 30-60 minutes at 4°C.
Pre-equilibrate 2.00 mL of Ni-NTA agarose resin with 10.0 mL of lysis buffer #1, wash buffer #2, or wash buffer #3.
Load clarified cell lysate onto the column and collect the flow-through.
Wash the column 1-3 times with 20.0 mL of wash buffer #1, wash buffer #2, or wash buffer #3.
Elute proteins from the column in 5.00-15.0 mL of elution buffer #1, elution buffer #2, or elution buffer #3 and collect the eluates.
Buffer exchange IMAC-purified proteins into high salt Tev cleavage buffer or low salt Tev cleavage buffer using Amicon Ultra-15 Centrifugal Filter Units.
Concentrate IMAC-purified proteins to ~1.0 mL using Amicon Ultra-15 Centrifugal Filter Units and add 6xHis-tagged Tobacco Etch Virus (TEV-6xHis) protease at a ~1:100 dilution.
Incubate the reaction overnight at 25°C.
Remove TEV-6xHis protease via secondary Ni-NTA IMAC purification, eluting proteins in 5.00 mL of lysis buffer #1 or lysis buffer #2.
Concentrate cleaved protein in Amicon Ultra-15 Centrifugal Filter Units.
Prepare IMAC-purified proteins at ≥1 mg·mL^-1^ for size-exclusion chromatography (SEC).
Apply IMAC-purified proteins to a Superdex 75 Increase 10/300 GL column or Superdex 200 Increase 10/300 GL column on an LC 1200 Series HPLC machine.
Elute SEC-purified proteins in high salt Tev cleavage buffer, Tris buffered saline (TBS), phosphate buffered saline (PBS), or Dulbecco's Phosphate-Buffered Saline without calcium or magnesium (DPBS).
Collect monomeric protein fractions from the column.
Concentrate collected protein fractions using Amicon Ultra-15 Centrifugal Filter Units with a 3 kDa cutoff.
Measure protein concentrations as in step 14 of "Large-scale bacterial expression and protein purification."

Inoculate 25.0 μL of overnight-grown cultures of Lemo21(DE3) E. coli into each well of Nunc 2.0 mL DeepWell 96-well plates containing 1.00 mL of LB media supplemented with 50.0 μg·mL^-1^ carbenicillin (pET15b).
Grow cells at 37°C and shaken at 1,200 rpm for 3-4 hours.
Add 500 µM IPTG final concentration to each well.
Induce protein expression for 4 hours at 37°C shaken at 1,200 rpm.
Pellet cells at 2,272x g for 2-5 minutes in a plate centrifuge.
Resuspend pellets in 50.0 μL of lysis buffer #1 supplemented with 1.00 mg·mL^-1 PMSF and a small amount of DNase I.
Transfer cells to skirted 96-well PCR plates and seal with adhesive foil covers for cell lysis via a microplate sonicator at 40-60% amplitude for 2-4 minutes in an ice bath.
Centrifuge crude cell lysates at 2,272x g for 5 minutes in a plate centrifuge.

Apply clarified cell lysates to His MultiTrap HP 96-well plates pre-equilibrated in lysis buffer #1 and undergo IMAC purification following the manufacturer's protocol except resin is washed three times in wash buffer #1 and eluted three times, each time using 50.0 μL of elution buffer #1.
Consolidate eluates into a single 96-well PCR plate.
